title: 注册学生社团培训第2单元（2016春）
source_doc: course/RSO Training Series/05_Spring 2016 RSO Training Module 2.md
author_source: project/RSO Training Series/05_Spring 2016 RSO Training Module 2/src.py

points.K1: 本课讲社团必知的校规
points.K7: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
points.K8: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
points.K11: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
points.K15: 不同观点分区，配合查验
points.K18: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
points.K23: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
points.K24: 罚单自己担，保险看手续

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园社团活动中心门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a campus student activity center with blank club banners and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲学生社团必知的校规。
overlay: 注册学生社团培训第2单元（2016春）

shots.scene: 五个图标：举起的手掌、举牌人群、酒杯、汽车、对话气泡
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a raised open palm, a small crowd holding blank signs, a wine glass, a car, and a speech bubble with a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 欺凌、抗议示威、饮酒、出行、反骚扰。

shots.scene: 阿杰在社团活动室兴奋地对着空白计划板比划
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gestures excitedly at a blank planning board in a student club room.
shots.narration: 阿杰当上社长，忙着策划迎新。

shots.scene: 空白计划板上画着啤酒杯、深夜月亮、汽车三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank planning board with three doodled icons: a beer mug, a night moon, and a car. No people.
shots.narration: 他想搞“入社考验”，再聚会、连夜自驾。

shots.scene: 小研皱眉，把一本空白手册放到他面前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns and places a blank handbook in front of the young male student.
shots.narration: 老社员小研说：学校对这些都有规定。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们一条一条来看。

shots.section_title: 本课讲社团必知的校规
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白校规手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a thick blank rule book on a desk.
shots.narration: 社团负责人，先要懂这几项校级政策。
overlay: 本课讲社团必知的校规

shots.scene: 一群学生围着一名新生，新生低头站着
shots.prompt_en: A group of students surround a new student who stands with head down in a club room. Simple cartoon, no faces in focus.
shots.narration: 明知而要求新人做事，换取入会资格，

shots.scene: 校园和校外街道两个图标，中间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a campus building and an off-campus street, with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 不管在校内还是校外，

shots.scene: 一个受伤的绷带图标和一个警示三角，旁边没有盖章的空白许可单
shots.prompt_en: A bandage icon and a yellow warning triangle beside a blank permission slip with no stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 未经学校许可，会伤人或可能伤人，就是。

shots.scene: 新生举手说“我愿意”，手势被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon icon of a raised hand saying yes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: “本人自愿”，不能为欺凌开脱。

shots.scene: 三个图标：疲惫的小人、酒瓶、惊吓的闪电，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: an exhausted stick figure, a liquor bottle, and a startling lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 累垮身心、强迫喝酒、身心惊吓，

shots.scene: 三个图标：木板、悬崖、哭脸面具，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: a wooden paddle, a cliff edge, and a crying mask. No people.
shots.narration: 体罚拍打、危险活动、侮辱人的游戏，

shots.scene: 三个图标：被拿走的背包、受伤的手臂、被推的小人，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: a taken backpack, an injured arm, and a pushed stick figure. No people.
shots.narration: 占用财物、伤害身体、逼人违法违规，

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜看一长串图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks through a magnifying glass at a long row of small crossed-out icons.
shots.narration: 这些只是举例，不是全部。

shots.scene: 空白处分决定书和一枚印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank disciplinary notice with a stamp beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 学生和社团，按学生纪律处分。

shots.scene: 老师、研究人员图标同样站在天平前
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a teacher and a researcher standing in front of a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 教职工、博士后、访问人员，按程序处理。

shots.scene: 法槌图标和一份空白起诉书
shots.prompt_en: A judge's gavel icon next to a blank charge document. No people.
shots.narration: 在本州，欺凌是犯罪，检察官可起诉。

shots.scene: 阿杰犹豫地看着手机，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks hesitantly at a phone with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 知道有欺凌，要及时报告。

shots.scene: 四个图标：学生事务楼、教务楼、校警徽章、人事办公室
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a student affairs building, an academic office, a campus police badge, and a human resources office. No people.
shots.narration: 找学生事务、教务、校警或人事部门。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁一个面具图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone hotline icon with a mask icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以打举报热线，匿名报告。

shots.section_title: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
shots.scene: 欣欣站在图书馆前，背后是灯泡和书本图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a library with light bulb and book icons floating above.
shots.narration: 大学靠研究和教学，发现和传播知识。
overlay: 大学需要交流，表达要负责

shots.section_title: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
shots.scene: 两个对话气泡交换灯泡
shots.prompt_en: Two speech bubbles exchanging a light bulb back and forth. No people.
shots.narration: 这需要思想的自由交流。

shots.section_title: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
shots.scene: 一个人举着空白牌子发言，另一人在旁倾听
shots.prompt_en: One student holds a blank sign and speaks while another student listens respectfully nearby.
shots.narration: 表达自由，也要维护别人的表达。

shots.section_title: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
shots.scene: 学生们举着空白标语牌在草坪上和平集会
shots.prompt_en: Students hold blank protest signs in a peaceful, orderly gathering on a campus lawn.
shots.narration: 和平有序的抗议示威，受到保护。
overlay: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人

shots.section_title: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
shots.scene: 教室、实验室、会议室图标被一条警戒线围着保护
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a classroom, a laboratory, and a meeting room protected by a ring of safety tape. No people.
shots.narration: 但不能干扰教学、科研、行政和会议。

shots.section_title: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
shots.scene: 推搡和堵门两个图标，打红叉，旁边空白处分决定书
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks, pushing people and blocking a doorway, beside a blank disciplinary notice. No people.
shots.narration: 危及他人安全的行为，禁止并受处分。

shots.scene: 老周站在集会现场边上，微笑着和学生交谈
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the side of a campus gathering and talks kindly with students holding blank signs.
shots.narration: 值班院长会到现场，维护开放讨论。

shots.scene: 老周递给阿杰一瓶水
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a bottle of water to the young male student at an outdoor gathering.
shots.narration: 他是来支持的，不是来处分的。

shots.scene: 户外场地和音量图标
shots.prompt_en: An outdoor lawn icon with a speaker and a volume bar. No people.
shots.narration: 户外活动，按户外活动规定执行。

shots.scene: 室内大厅图标，人数计数器指向上限
shots.prompt_en: An indoor hall icon with a people counter needle pointing to a red limit mark. No people.
shots.narration: 室内活动，注意容量限制和大家的安全。

shots.section_title: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
shots.scene: 学生举着空白小牌子站在走廊一边
shots.prompt_en: Students hold small blank signs and stand along one side of a wide corridor, leaving the path clear.
shots.narration: 标语、横幅、指示牌，一般都允许。
overlay: 标语器材要安全，按时离场

shots.section_title: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
shots.scene: 过长的杆子横幅挡住通道的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a long banner pole blocking a corridor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险或妨碍别人，要换地方或撤掉。

shots.section_title: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
shots.scene: 时钟指向闭馆时间，门口的人有序离开
shots.prompt_en: A wall clock beside a building door at closing time; students walk out in an orderly line.
shots.narration: 在楼里活动，到闭馆时间就离场。

shots.scene: 阿杰和老周一起看空白校园地图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the older man look at a blank campus map together.
shots.narration: 组织者先找活动中心和指导老师沟通。

shots.scene: 地图上一个地点被圈出，一条路线箭头连到另一栋楼
shots.prompt_en: A blank campus map with one place circled and a route arrow to another building. No people.
shots.narration: 地点要批准，要移动或进楼也写进申请。

shots.scene: 日历上活动日之前两格被标记
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with the two days before an event day highlighted and a submit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 至少提前48小时提交并获批准。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师站在活动现场
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator stand together at the edge of a campus gathering.
shots.narration: 指导老师和值班院长在现场保障安全。

shots.scene: 校门外的马路图标和一个空白市政许可文件
shots.prompt_en: A road outside a campus gate icon with a blank city permit document. No people.
shots.narration: 上校外人行道和街道，要办市政许可。

shots.scene: 红绿灯图标，绿灯亮
shots.prompt_en: A traffic light icon showing green, beside a small crowd icon. No people.
shots.narration: 活动一般可以持续进行。

shots.scene: 红绿灯变红，旁边是教室和实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: The traffic light turns red, next to classroom and laboratory icons. No people.
shots.narration: 运行受损、侵犯他人权利，学校就叫停。

shots.scene: 关闭的楼门和一副手铐图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed building door icon next to a pair of handcuffs icon. No people.
shots.narration: 赖在关闭的楼里，可能被逮捕起诉。

shots.section_title: 不同观点分区，配合查验
shots.scene: 场地平面图分成两块区域，中间有通道
shots.prompt_en: A blank floor plan divided into two separate zones with an aisle between them. No people.
shots.narration: 观点不同的活动，可另划区域。
overlay: 不同观点分区，配合查验

shots.section_title: 不同观点分区，配合查验
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员站在活动现场边
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands calmly at the edge of a campus gathering.
shots.narration: 为了安全，校警可以派警员到场。

shots.section_title: 不同观点分区，配合查验
shots.scene: 学生向保卫处值班员出示空白证件
shots.prompt_en: A student shows a blank ID card to the security officer.
shots.narration: 工作人员要求时，出示学校或政府证件。

shots.scene: 成年人图标举着一小杯酒，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An adult figure icon holding a small glass, with a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 合法饮酒年龄的人，可在批准活动中适量喝。

shots.scene: 数字21的生日蛋糕图标旁，酒瓶递给年轻人的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A birthday cake icon beside an icon of a bottle handed to a young person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 本州法律：不满21岁不得饮酒持酒。

shots.scene: 酒瓶递给年轻人的手被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A hand passing a bottle to a young person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不得向他们提供酒。

shots.scene: 空白指南和申请表，日历上提前两周圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank guideline booklet and application form next to a calendar with a date two weeks earlier circled. No people.
shots.narration: 活动供酒，先读指南签申请表。

shots.scene: 老周在空白表格上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank form at a desk.
shots.narration: 至少提前两周交指导老师审批。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 侍酒人图标戴着袖标和培训证书
shots.prompt_en: A server figure icon wearing an armband, with a blank training certificate beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 供酒人须满21岁，并完成专门培训。
overlay: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 时钟和人数图标指向一个酒量刻度
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon and a head count icon pointing to a drink amount gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 供应量由活动中心按时长和人数定。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 两个人形图标：学生和教职工，全程站在酒桌旁
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons, a student and a staff member, standing by a drinks table the whole time. No people.
shots.narration: 指定一名学生、一名教职工全程在场。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 啤酒和葡萄酒打勾，烈酒瓶打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A beer glass and a wine glass with green checks; a strong liquor bottle crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只供啤酒和葡萄酒，不供烈酒。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 王老师在门口查看空白证件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank ID card at an event entrance.
shots.narration: 可能有未满21岁者，由教职工查证供酒。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 三个小酒杯图标，第四个打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three small drink glass icons in a row and a fourth one crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 每名学生最多三杯，活动短的更少。

shots.scene: 未成年人图标被一道屏障挡在酒桌外
shots.prompt_en: A minor figure icon kept away from a drinks table by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 确保未满21岁的人接触不到酒。

shots.scene: 果汁、矿泉水、面包、水果图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of juice, bottled water, bread and fruit on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 备足无酒精饮料和不咸的食物。

shots.scene: 自带酒瓶和带酒杯的海报，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a bottle brought from outside, and a poster with a wine glass on it. No people.
shots.narration: 只在批准区域喝，不自带，宣传不提酒。

shots.scene: 时钟显示最后半小时，酒杯被收起
shots.prompt_en: A clock showing the last half hour of an event; glasses are being cleared away. No people.
shots.narration: 活动最后半小时，停止供酒。

shots.scene: 阿杰背着书包，书本放在旅行包上面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with a backpack, a stack of books placed on top of a travel bag.
shots.narration: 出行要合宗旨，你首先是学生。

shots.scene: 空白在线登记表提前提交，日历上标出十个工作日
shots.prompt_en: A blank online travel registration form being submitted early, with ten workdays marked on a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 至少提前10个工作日在线登记。

shots.scene: 老周在空白登记表上盖章
shots.prompt_en: The older man stamps a blank travel form with approval.
shots.narration: 指导老师审核批准后，才能出发。

shots.scene: 私家车、租赁车、校车三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three car icons: a private car, a rental car, and a school vehicle. No people.
shots.narration: 开私家车、租车、校车，都守车辆政策。

shots.scene: 空白名单，每行都有人名、账号、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank roster with a name icon, an account icon and a phone icon on each line. No people.
shots.narration: 登记全体学生姓名、校园账号和手机。

shots.scene: 未经批准的出行箭头被红叉划掉，旁边一个空钱袋
shots.prompt_en: A travel arrow crossed out with a red X, beside an empty money bag. No people.
shots.narration: 未批准或登记不实，要处分，不报销。

shots.scene: 驾照图标和数字18的生日蛋糕图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank driver license card and a birthday cake. No people.
shots.narration: 驾驶员满18岁，租车按租车公司要求。

shots.scene: 日历和里程表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a calendar showing two years and an odometer. No people.
shots.narration: 驾照满两年，驾驶超过2000英里。

shots.scene: 干净的空白记录单打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean blank driving record sheet with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 无违法、定罪和法院监管记录，每年重申。

shots.section_title: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
shots.scene: 一叠空白表格和驾照复印件放进文件袋，日历提前两周
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank forms and a copy of a blank license going into a folder, with a calendar two weeks ahead. No people.
shots.narration: 出行前至少两周，交驾驶审批材料。
overlay: 驾驶审批材料要提前交

shots.section_title: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
shots.scene: 租赁车图标旁三份空白表格
shots.prompt_en: A rental car icon with three blank forms beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 租车要交确认书、授权书、驾照正反面。

shots.section_title: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
shots.scene: 私家车图标旁多了协议、检查单和保险单
shots.prompt_en: A private car icon with an extra blank agreement, inspection checklist and insurance card beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 开私家车，再加协议、车检表和保险证明。

shots.section_title: 罚单自己担，保险看手续
shots.scene: 罚单图标落在司机图标手里
shots.prompt_en: A blank ticket icon landing in the hand of a driver icon. No people.
shots.narration: 交通和停车罚单，司机自己负责。
overlay: 罚单自己担，保险看手续

shots.section_title: 罚单自己担，保险看手续
shots.scene: 学校被罚的账单转给社团钱袋
shots.prompt_en: A blank fine bill sent from a university icon to a club money bag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 学校因此被罚的，由社团偿还。

shots.section_title: 罚单自己担，保险看手续
shots.scene: 租车柜台的保险单被红叉划掉，盾牌罩住租赁车
shots.prompt_en: A rental counter insurance form crossed out with a red X, and a shield covering a rental car icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不用另买租车保险，学校保险覆盖。

shots.scene: 车内乘客都系好安全带
shots.prompt_en: Inside a car, the young male student and the female graduate student fasten their seat belts.
shots.narration: 守交规，全车人员始终系好安全带。

shots.scene: 酒杯和药丸挡在方向盘前，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A wine glass and a pill in front of a steering wheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不酒驾，不毒驾，驾照随身带。

shots.scene: 陌生人搭车的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stranger hitchhiking at the roadside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不搭载与活动无关的人。

shots.scene: 雨、雾、雪、冰四个天气图标，旁边一个停着的车
shots.prompt_en: Four weather icons: heavy rain, fog, snow and ice, beside a parked car. No people.
shots.narration: 大雨、雾、雪、冰，不开车。

shots.scene: 发动机、刹车、车灯、方向盘图标带问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an engine, brakes, headlights and a steering wheel, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 发动机、刹车、灯光、转向有故障，不开。

shots.scene: 司机手机、调音响、吃东西三个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a phone in a driver's hand, adjusting a radio, and eating while driving. No people.
shots.narration: 开车不调音响手机，不吃喝不吸烟。

shots.scene: 音量条很低，旁边喇叭图标
shots.prompt_en: A low volume bar next to a car horn icon with sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 音量低到能听见喇叭，不打电话发短信。

shots.scene: 长长的公路和一个打哈欠的司机图标
shots.prompt_en: A long highway icon and a yawning driver icon with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 超过250英里的长途，要防疲劳。

shots.scene: 两个时钟图标：3小时和6小时
shots.prompt_en: Two clock icons with different amounts shaded, next to a steering wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 每人连续开不超3小时，一天不超6小时。

shots.scene: 车内坐着的学生图标和一个24小时钟
shots.prompt_en: A seated passenger icon and a 24-hour clock with part shaded. No people.
shots.narration: 学生24小时内乘车不超过16小时。

shots.scene: 副驾驶上的小研清醒地看着前方
shots.prompt_en: Inside a car, the female graduate student sits awake in the passenger seat, watching the road.
shots.narration: 副驾驶始终要有一个清醒的人。

shots.scene: 月亮和星星下的公路，汽车图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A highway under the moon and stars, with a car icon crossed out by a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 午夜到早上6点，不开车。

shots.scene: 电话图标连到风险管理办公室和审批部门图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon connected by lines to a risk management office icon and an approval office icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出事立即报风险管理办和审批部门。

shots.scene: 手机屏幕上显示大大的拨号键盘
shots.prompt_en: A phone screen showing a large dial pad. No people.
shots.narration: 需要紧急救助，拨打911。

shots.scene: 空白罚单交到老师手里
shots.prompt_en: A blank traffic ticket handed to a teacher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 所有交通罚单，都要报告审批部门。

shots.scene: 阿杰深呼吸，表情冷静
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a deep breath and stays calm beside a parked car at the roadside.
shots.narration: 保持冷静，对人有礼貌。

shots.scene: 车辆停到路边，钥匙图标熄火
shots.prompt_en: A car moved to the road shoulder and a key icon turning the engine off. No people.
shots.narration: 尽快把车移出车道，熄火。

shots.scene: 空白笔记本上画着车辆、车牌、人名图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook with sketches of a car, a blank license plate and a name tag. No people.
shots.narration: 记下对方姓名住址、车辆和车牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰向警察递出空白信息卡，嘴上画着拉链
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a blank info card to a police officer, with a small zipper icon over his mouth.
shots.narration: 把自己的信息给对方和警察，不评论过错。

shots.scene: 五个人形图标被圈出，外面的人群打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Five person icons inside a circle, while a crowd outside the circle is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只和警方、车主、租车方、老师谈事故。

shots.scene: 日历上10月被圈出，旁边一个培训图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with October circled, next to a training icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这部分，10月的社团培训有专题。

shots.scene: 骚扰、跟踪、暴力三个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: an unwanted touching hand, a shadow following a person, and a raised fist. No people.
shots.narration: 不容性骚扰、性侵、家暴、约会暴力、跟踪。

shots.scene: 不同肤色、性别、年龄的人形图标手拉手
shots.prompt_en: Icons of diverse people of different ages and genders holding hands in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 不因种族、宗教、性别、年龄等受歧视。

shots.scene: 四个图标：值班院长、校警徽章、医院十字、心形
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a dean on duty figure, a campus police badge, a medical cross, and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 值班院长、校警、健康和心理服务。

shots.scene: 电脑上空白网页和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A computer showing a blank web page with a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有性暴力预防资源和汇总网站。

shots.scene: 小研把求助电话存进手机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student saves contact numbers into her phone.
shots.narration: 把这些求助电话，存进手机。

shots.scene: 空白测验卷和一支笔
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz sheet and a pencil on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 做完测验，进入第3单元。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上有四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with four icons: a raised palm, a crowd with blank signs, a wine glass, and a car.
shots.narration: 最后，记住几句话。

shots.scene: 举起的手掌图标
shots.prompt_en: A raised open palm icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 拒绝欺凌，“自愿”也不行。

shots.scene: 举牌人群和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A crowd icon with blank signs next to a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 示威和平有序，提前48小时申请。

shots.scene: 三个小酒杯和数字21图标
shots.prompt_en: Three small drink glass icons next to an ID card icon. No people.
shots.narration: 供酒提前两周审批，满21岁，最多三杯。

shots.scene: 汽车、安全带和月亮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a car, a seat belt and a moon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 出行提前登记，系好安全带，夜里不开。

shots.scene: 阿杰把空白计划板上的深夜月亮擦掉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student erases the night moon doodle from the planning board and smiles.
shots.narration: 阿杰按校规改了迎新方案。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在社团招新摊位前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student and the female graduate student in front of a club booth.
shots.narration: 按规矩办社团，下次见！
